cases.input: A Python analyzer separately parses a standalone invalid type comment, reports the preceding statement's line, and passes that statement as diagnostic carrier despite available comment coordinates.
cases.rationale: The public symptom and inspected carrier match the supported mechanism.

cases.input: A type-comment syntax-error diagnostic has an incorrect line, but its position source has not been inspected.
cases.rationale: Probe current owners and the coordinate source before editing.

cases.input: An ordinary Python syntax error without a type comment has an incorrect caret position.
cases.rationale: The separately parsed type-comment mechanism is absent.
